description: Use this when someone asks whether AI engines can read their own brand's site, based on CueScout's last audit of it: crawler access, llms.txt, schema, meta tags, server-rendered copy, and about and pricing pages. Reads the stored result; it does not re-run the audit.

brand.description: Which brand, by name or id, when the account tracks more than one. Leave empty to use the only brand; list_brands shows them all.

name: get_site_audit
title: Show the brand's site audit
